welcome.text: Hello, and welcome. I'm going to take a quick, contactless health check. It takes about a minute and a half, and you won't need to touch anything.

ask_name.text: To begin, could you please tell me your name?

name_retry.text: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say your name once more?

name_type.text: No problem. You can type your name on the screen instead.

name_confirm_q.when: after showing the heard name on screen

name_thanks.text: Thank you. Lovely to meet you.

settle.text: Let's get you comfortable. Please sit upright and look at the screen.

no_face.text: I can't see your face just yet. Could you look towards the camera, please?

farther.text: Could you move back just a little?

move_left.text: Please move a little to your left.
move_left.when: face off-centre (CHECK mirror direction at integration)

move_right.text: Please move a little to your right.
move_right.when: face off-centre (CHECK mirror direction at integration)

keep_in_circle.text: Please keep your face inside the circle.

more_light.text: It's a little dark here. Could you face a light, or move somewhere brighter?

too_bright.text: It's quite bright. Try turning a little away from the light.

hold_still.text: Please try to stay as still as you can.

stay_quiet.text: Please try not to talk during the scan. Just breathe naturally.

remove_cover.text: If you're wearing a mask or covering your face, please take it off for the scan.
remove_cover.when: face found but low signal quality

count_in.text: I'll start in just a moment.

scan_start.text: Starting now. Breathe normally, and stay as still as you can.

mid_1.text: You're doing really well. Just keep breathing naturally.

mid_2.text: Nice and steady. You're doing great.

done.text: All done. Thank you so much for your patience.

handoff_normal.text: A member of our team will be with you shortly.

handoff_urgent.text: Please stay where you are. A member of our team is on their way to you.

name_check.text: Please check your name on the screen. Is that right?

ask_age.text: Thank you. And how old are you?

age_retry.text: Sorry, I didn't catch your age. Could you say it once more?
age_retry.when: STT could not parse an age

age_type.text: No problem. You can enter your age on the screen.

ask_sex.text: Are you male, female, or would you rather not say?

sex_type.text: No problem. You can choose on the screen.

ask_complaint.text: Now, in your own words, what brings you in today?

complaint_thanks.text: Thank you. I've noted that down.

complaint_skip.text: That's fine. You can tell the nurse when you're called.

tap_or_say.text: You can tap the screen, or just say it.

please_take_seat.text: Please take a seat. We'll call your number when it's your turn.

stay_seated.text: Please stay seated and keep an eye on the screen. It will show when it's your turn.

wait_soon.text: You should be seen very shortly.

wait_long.text: It may be longer than two hours. Please ask at the desk if you'd like an update.

no_token.text: I couldn't print your number, but you're registered. Please tell the desk your name.

weak_signal.text: I'm sorry, I couldn't get a clear reading. Shall we try once more?

retry.text: Let's try that again. Please look at the screen and stay still.

camera_error.text: I can't reach the camera right now. Please let a member of staff know.

mic_error.text: I can't hear you at the moment. You can type your name on the screen instead.
